title: Fix Flow Selection Marquee Overlay
description: Flow selection is live and working but the selection rectangle/lasso overlay is not showing (unlike 3d). Rust publishes selection preview points as [[x,y],...] while computeDagMarqueeOverlay expects [{x,y},...] objects, producing NaN bounds and an invisible marquee. Fix the overlay point parsing at the shared React path, wire selectionPreviewMethod for lasso, and cover the tuple JSON format in tests.
